The teacher's corrections on this scene:
- 然后教他怎么买又便宜又好质量的东西：质量又好

The system's item in each run:
Run 1: 又便宜又好质量的东西：又便宜又质量好的东西，The phrase for “good quality” is formed with the noun followed by the adjective, so the two descriptions can be parallel. [rule: none]
Run 2: 又便宜又好质量的东西：又便宜又质量好的东西，质量 is a noun, so the description should use 质量好 rather than 好质量. [rule: none]
